routes, and mar"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"k the models you want to use in **Settings → Models**."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Features in detail"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Vision understanding and `inspect_image`"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Configure a provider/model in the **Models** page first, then pick the pair under **Vision understan"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ding** (saved as `vision.provider` + `vision.model`). `tool.enabled` independently controls whether "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"the `inspect_image` tool is registered."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Once enabled, ask the agent to run `inspect_image` on a Host-readable path:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"> Use inspect_image to analyze screenshots/error.png"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The tool commits the file through the `ctx.attachments` seam and asks the selected vision model, ret"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"urning a text answer (optionally truncated at `vision.maxTokens`). PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF are supp"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" a text answer (optionally truncated at `vision.maxTokens`). PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF are supported."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Model capability mark**: for a user-configured `llm-pi-ai` model, the **Allow image input** checkb"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ox in the model's settings writes its canonical `input` declaration (`[text, image]` when checked, `"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"[text]` when cleared). Both `inspect_image` and the main chat composer read that same capability fac"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"t. The declaration cannot add vision to a text-only model — only check it when the upstream endpoint"},{"id":"p21s5","text":" actually accepts images."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Image handoff (chat images with a text-only main model)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"When **Image handoff** (`vision.handoff`, default on) is enabled with a vision route selected, image"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" delivery is native-first and falls back safely for routes without declared image support:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. A runtime wrapper on `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo` claims image input for text-only main routes whil"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"e handoff is active, so the image admission preflight passes (the model catalog and per-model checkb"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"oxes are unaffected because they read the settings document directly). The configured auxiliary visi"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"on route is never inflated, so `inspect_image`/`describe_image` still reject a mistakenly selected t"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ext-only vision model.
2. For each request containing images, a listener on the official `llm/stream"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"` waterfall checks the exact request's provider/model through the original capability resolver. Imag"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"e-capable routes receive the original `ImageBlock`s unchanged. Text-only routes and routes with unde"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"clared modalities receive durable text references such as `[image: {"attachmentId":…,"mediaType":…}]"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"`; nested images in tool results are rewritten too.
3. The system prompt tells a text-only main mode"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"l to call `describe_image` with the exact JSON from the reference; the tool reads the stored attachm"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"ent bytes, asks the selected vision model, and returns a text description."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The rewrite is immutable and request-local, so concurrent native and fallback streams cannot affect "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"one another; aborts, errors, early iterator closure, and plugin disposal retain the host stream sema"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ntics. References are plain text and therefore survive restarts, forks, and replays. Both seams are "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"plugin-side; no core package is modified. Disable `vision.handoff` to restore the original admission"},{"id":"p25s5","text":" and stream behavior."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Skipping injection for vision-capable main models"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The plugin consumes dsh-loader 2.x facades.
